hook.en: In 1511 Melaka was one of the busiest ports in the world. Within a few months it fell to Portuguese cannons — and the Malay world entered a new era of Western powers.
hook.bm: Pada 1511 Melaka ialah antara pelabuhan paling sibuk di dunia. Dalam beberapa bulan ia jatuh ke tangan meriam Portugis — dan Alam Melayu memasuki era baharu kuasa Barat.

bigIdeas.en: Western powers came for trade (especially spices), power and to spread their influence.
bigIdeas.bm: Kuasa Barat datang untuk perdagangan (terutamanya rempah), kuasa dan menyebarkan pengaruh.

bigIdeas.en: Portugal took Melaka in 1511; the Dutch took it in 1641.
bigIdeas.bm: Portugis menawan Melaka pada 1511; Belanda menawannya pada 1641.

bigIdeas.en: Britain gained Penang (1786) and Singapore (1819); the 1824 treaty split the region between Britain and the Netherlands.
bigIdeas.bm: Britain memperoleh Pulau Pinang (1786) dan Singapura (1819); perjanjian 1824 membahagikan rantau ini antara Britain dan Belanda.

detail.en: The Dutch take Melaka from Portugal
Anglo-Dutch Treaty divides the Malay world

definition.en: A strong country extending its power over other lands.
definition.bm: Negara kuat meluaskan kuasanya ke atas wilayah lain.

definition.en: Sole control over trade in a product.
definition.bm: Kawalan penuh ke atas perdagangan sesuatu barangan.

definition.en: An area where one power has control or special rights.
definition.bm: Kawasan yang dikuasai atau diberi hak istimewa kepada sesuatu kuasa.

definition.en: British trading company that acquired Penang and Singapore.
definition.bm: Syarikat perdagangan British yang memperoleh Pulau Pinang dan Singapura.

question.en: Explain TWO reasons Britain wanted Penang in 1786.
question.bm: Jelaskan DUA sebab British mahukan Pulau Pinang pada 1786.

steps.en: A port to repair and supply ships on the route between India and China.
steps.bm: Pelabuhan untuk membaiki dan membekalkan kapal dalam laluan antara India dan China.

steps.en: A base to protect and expand British trade in the region against the Dutch.
steps.bm: Pangkalan untuk melindungi dan meluaskan perdagangan British di rantau ini bagi menyaingi Belanda.

prompt.en: In which year did Portugal capture Melaka?
prompt.bm: Pada tahun berapakah Portugis menawan Melaka?

explanation.en: Alfonso de Albuquerque led the attack in 1511.
explanation.bm: Alfonso de Albuquerque mengetuai serangan pada 1511.

prompt.en: Who led the Portuguese attack on Melaka?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang mengetuai serangan Portugis ke atas Melaka?

explanation.en: He was the Portuguese commander in the East.

prompt.en: The Dutch took Melaka from the Portuguese in…
prompt.bm: Belanda mengambil Melaka daripada Portugis pada…

explanation.en: The Dutch were helped by Johor.

prompt.en: Who occupied Penang for the British in 1786?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang menduduki Pulau Pinang bagi pihak British pada 1786?

explanation.en: He negotiated with Sultan Abdullah of Kedah.
explanation.bm: Beliau berunding dengan Sultan Abdullah dari Kedah.

prompt.en: Singapore was opened by Stamford ______ in 1819.
prompt.bm: Singapura dibuka oleh Stamford ______ pada 1819.

explanation.en: He saw Singapore's strategic position at the southern tip of the Peninsula.
explanation.bm: Beliau melihat kedudukan strategik Singapura di hujung selatan Semenanjung.

prompt.en: Penang was obtained from the ruler of which state?
prompt.bm: Pulau Pinang diperoleh daripada pemerintah negeri manakah?

explanation.en: Sultan Abdullah of Kedah hoped for British help against Siam.
explanation.bm: Sultan Abdullah Kedah mengharapkan bantuan British menentang Siam.

prompt.en: The Anglo-Dutch Treaty was signed in…
prompt.bm: Perjanjian Inggeris-Belanda ditandatangani pada…

explanation.en: It was signed in London on 17 March 1824.
explanation.bm: Ia ditandatangani di London pada 17 Mac 1824.

prompt.en: What was the main product Western powers sought in the Malay world?
prompt.bm: Apakah barangan utama yang dicari kuasa Barat di Alam Melayu?

explanation.en: Spices such as pepper, cloves and nutmeg were very valuable in Europe.
explanation.bm: Rempah seperti lada, cengkih dan pala sangat bernilai di Eropah.

prompt.en: Select ALL motives of Western powers in the East.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA motif kuasa Barat ke Timur.

explanation.en: Often summed up as "Gold, Gospel and Glory".
explanation.bm: Sering diringkaskan sebagai "Gold, Gospel and Glory".

prompt.en: Arrange these events in time order.
prompt.bm: Susun peristiwa ini mengikut kronologi.

prompt.en: Match each result of the 1824 treaty.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap kesan perjanjian 1824.

explanation.en: This later shaped the borders of Malaysia and Indonesia.
explanation.bm: Ini kemudian membentuk sempadan Malaysia dan Indonesia.

prompt.en: What was a major effect of the Anglo-Dutch Treaty on the Johor-Riau kingdom?
prompt.bm: Apakah kesan utama Perjanjian Inggeris-Belanda ke atas kerajaan Johor-Riau?

explanation.en: The Malay world was divided without the consent of the local rulers.
explanation.bm: Alam Melayu dibahagikan tanpa persetujuan pemerintah tempatan.

options.en: It was split into two: Johor under British influence and Riau under Dutch influence
options.bm: Ia terbahagi dua: Johor di bawah pengaruh British dan Riau di bawah pengaruh Belanda

prompt.en: Why was Singapore's location attractive to the British?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah kedudukan Singapura menarik minat British?

explanation.en: A free port there could challenge Dutch trade.
explanation.bm: Pelabuhan bebas di situ boleh menyaingi perdagangan Belanda.

options.en: It lay on the main sea route between India and China at the tip of the Peninsula
options.bm: Ia terletak di laluan laut utama antara India dan China di hujung Semenanjung
Ia mempunyai lombong emas yang besar

options.en: It was far from the sea

prompt.en: Which Malay kingdom helped the Dutch capture Melaka in 1641?
prompt.bm: Kerajaan Melayu manakah membantu Belanda menawan Melaka pada 1641?

explanation.en: Johor and the Dutch were both rivals of the Portuguese.
explanation.bm: Johor dan Belanda sama-sama menentang Portugis.

prompt.en: Sultan Abdullah of Kedah allowed the British into Penang mainly because he hoped for…
prompt.bm: Sultan Abdullah Kedah membenarkan British ke Pulau Pinang terutamanya kerana mengharapkan…

explanation.en: The British later refused to help, and Kedah was attacked by Siam in 1821.
explanation.bm: British kemudian enggan membantu, dan Kedah diserang Siam pada 1821.

prompt.en: A port where traders pay little or no tax is called a ______ port.
prompt.bm: Pelabuhan yang pedagangnya membayar sedikit atau tiada cukai dipanggil pelabuhan ______.

explanation.en: Singapore grew quickly as a free port.
explanation.bm: Singapura berkembang pesat sebagai pelabuhan bebas.

prompt.en: Why can the Anglo-Dutch Treaty 1824 be called unfair to the Malay world?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Perjanjian Inggeris-Belanda 1824 boleh dianggap tidak adil kepada Alam Melayu?

explanation.en: Families and kingdoms with long ties were separated.
explanation.bm: Keluarga dan kerajaan yang lama berhubungan dipisahkan.

options.en: Two foreign powers divided Malay lands without asking the Malay rulers
options.bm: Dua kuasa asing membahagikan tanah Melayu tanpa bertanya kepada raja-raja Melayu

options.en: It gave the Malays all of Sumatra
options.bm: Ia memberi seluruh Sumatera kepada orang Melayu

prompt.en: What lesson can Malaysia learn from the fall of Melaka in 1511?
prompt.bm: Apakah pengajaran kepada Malaysia daripada kejatuhan Melaka pada 1511?

explanation.en: Internal weaknesses made Melaka easier to conquer.

options.en: Unity, strong defence and good leadership are needed to protect sovereignty
options.bm: Perpaduan, pertahanan yang kuat dan kepimpinan yang baik diperlukan untuk melindungi kedaulatan

prompt.en: How did the British way of gaining Penang differ from Portugal's way of gaining Melaka?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah cara British memperoleh Pulau Pinang berbeza daripada cara Portugis memperoleh Melaka?

explanation.en: Francis Light promised help against Siam, which was never given.
explanation.bm: Francis Light menjanjikan bantuan menentang Siam, yang tidak pernah diberikan.

options.en: Britain used negotiation and promises; Portugal used military conquest
options.bm: Britain menggunakan rundingan dan janji; Portugis menggunakan penaklukan ketenteraan

options.en: Britain bought it with gold only

prompt.en: Which present-day boundary is a long-term result of the 1824 treaty?
prompt.bm: Sempadan masa kini manakah kesan jangka panjang perjanjian 1824?

explanation.en: British areas became Malaysia and Singapore; Dutch areas became Indonesia.
explanation.bm: Kawasan British menjadi Malaysia dan Singapura; kawasan Belanda menjadi Indonesia.

options.en: The sea boundary between Malaysia/Singapore and Indonesia
options.bm: Sempadan laut antara Malaysia/Singapura dengan Indonesia

options.en: The border between Malaysia and Thailand only
The border of Brunei and Sarawak
